disposition_definition.unchanged: No material previously missing public dependency is established for the requested customer decision; original-backed branch and case-specific missing facts are reassessed. Added contextual support may still narrow interpretation.
disposition_definition.partially_resolved: A specified public-source requirement is newly supported, often for a clearly conditional alternative; issued/customer or other material source dependencies remain.
disposition_definition.resolved: All stated public-source dependencies in this follow-up are resolved, not a customer-advice success.

method: Individually authored assessments preserve canonical questions, facts and numeric stipulations. Selected original passages and connected exceptions are read for new dependencies; no complete customer decision is inferred from a new public wording.
